tbesh_html:
1) to wait, wait for, await
1a) (Qal) to wait for
1b) (Piel)
1b1) to wait, tarry
1b2) to wait (in ambush)
1b3) to wait for, long for

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, to adhere to; hence, to await
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root (apparently akin to H2707 (חָקָה) through the idea of piercing);
